youtube.title: The sky is NOT blue because of the ocean 🌊 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Most people say the sky is blue because it reflects the ocean. It doesn't, and the sky is just as blue over a desert. Our air is full of tiny nitrogen and oxygen molecules, and as sunlight passes through they knock the blue light in every direction. It is sunlight bouncing off the air itself. Full episode on the channel.
